greet:
Hello, welcome to City Care Clinic.

Tap an option below, or just type your message.
menu.book.label: Book an appointment
menu.book.text: I want to book an appointment
menu.cancel.label: Cancel an appointment
menu.cancel.text: I want to cancel an appointment
menu.question.label: FAQ
menu.question.text: I have a question about the clinic
verify.no_match: Those details don't match our records. If you are new to the clinic, I can register you here.
register.no_match: I couldn't register you with those details. If you have visited us before, please share your registered mobile number and date of birth, or call the front desk at 080 0000 1234.
verify.locked: For your security I can't check those details right now. Please call the front desk at 080 0000 1234.
diagnosis.refusal: I can't diagnose, but I can help you see the right doctor.
medication.refusal: I'm not able to give any advice about medicines, including doses, timing or what a medicine is for. A doctor can help with that. Would you like me to book a consultation?
off_topic: I can help with appointments and questions about City Care Clinic.
emergency.note: If this is an emergency, please call 108 or 112, or go to the nearest hospital.
self_harm.note: If you're having thoughts of harming yourself, you don't have to face it alone. Tele-MANAS is free and open 24x7 at 14416, or call 112 if you are in immediate danger.
handoff.text: I've asked the front desk to call you back. Your reference number is {ticket}. You can also reach them at 080 0000 1234.
handoff.ended: This chat has ended. Please start a new chat if you need anything else.
faq.no_match: I don't have that information. The front desk can help at 080 0000 1234. Would you like me to ask them to call you?
confirm.readback: Please check your booking: {doctor}, {specialty}, on {date} at {time}. This is a {visit_type} visit. Shall I confirm it?
booked.text: Your appointment with {doctor} on {date} at {time} is booked.
booked.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
busy: Sorry, I'm a little busy right now. Please send your message again in a moment.
internal_error: Sorry, something went wrong on my side. You can call the front desk at 080 0000 1234, or I can ask them to call you.
input_truncated: Your message was long, so I read only the first part of it.
cancel.done: Your appointment with {doctor} on {date} at {time} is cancelled. Is there anything else I can help you with?
handoff.no_ticket: Please call the front desk at 080 0000 1234 and they will help you.
